name: Satrix RAFI 40 ETF
index_rules: The mandate of the Satrix RAFI 40 ETF (“Satrix RAFI 40 “) is to track, as closely as possible, the value of the FTSE/JSE RAFI 40 Index (J260). Satrix RAFI 40 is an index tracking fund, registered as a Collective Investment Scheme, and is also listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange as an Exchange Traded Fund. Satrix RAFI 40 provides investors with the price performance of the FTSE/JSE RAFI 40 Index (J260) as well as pays out, on a quarterly basis, all dividends received from companies comprising the index, net of cost.
